power.supply: 12V Adaptor for NVR, 48V adaptor for PoE (additional 48V adaptor for external hub)

features: Video input: 8 IP cameras plus 8 through the external 8-channel PoE extension hub included with the NR16H
HD 1080p recording up to 480 fps; max. 30 FPS @ 1080p per channel
External storage: NAS, eSATA, FTP; HDD 3-15TB
Monitoring for fan failure and temperature; HDD S.M.A.R.T. notification
